title: The Elephant Man and Other Reminiscences

This poignant narrative sets the stage for a deeper exploration of Merrick’s struggles, humanity, and eventual shelter in a hospital, paving the way for a heartwarming and tragic story about suffering, dignity, and the quest for acceptance.
